# Separate grievance from ticket

`customer_support.pb.de_escalation.separate_grievance_from_ticket` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Track the relationship damage as its own item, not as a field on the ticket that closes with it.

Closing the ticket is not closing the grievance, and a queue that only carries tickets loses the second one at exactly the moment the account starts quietly shopping.
